_doc: Style frames: each is a real frame of the cue-driven scene. 'shot' and 't' come from camera/cues.json; the light state is whatever the cue stack says at t. Poses/setups are previs blocking stand-ins until Milestone 4.

sf01_meter_asleep.caption: Asleep. The Meter (Pos A, 32 mm): the sign, the display at 11 MIN, Noor under P1 and all 12 panels countable. Passing lights only in the glass.

sf02_first_flicker.caption: Cue 1, 'Just leaving the office now.' P1 drops to 30% on the first frame of the flicker. Pos C on the 40 mm, tilted so the ceiling enters (the car is awake). Walter's shoulder is in the foreground.

sf03_brownout.caption: Cue 3: 'I'm at the library, Mum.' BROWN (2200 K, -2.5 stops) holds on every panel. Bea is across from Walter; the strap is the most saturated thing in frame.

sf04a_blackout.caption: Cue 4: blackout. Every pixel is 0, after the painterly comp too.

sf04b_lights_up.caption: Cue 4.up, the same locked Meter: Kai's seat is empty and his phone glows on the cushion. The car is indifferent.

sf05_two_panels_left.caption: After 7.10, two panels left (Pos A2, where the creep push lands). Noor is in the last pool with MARK glowing in her lap; Walter and Bea sit at the hard edge; Kai's phone is the only light in the dark.

sf06_confession_75.caption: Shot 58 on the 75 mm, the push landed: 'I'm sorry.' Sculpted Noor (design/sheets/noor.svg) under P1 at 110%. Exposed for her face, with the darker end-wall panel about a stop under her and her eyes on the upper third.

sf07_relight_run.caption: Cues 8.3-8.7: the relights run toward the Meter. Kai's empty seat (P8) has just come back, with its 110% overshoot on P9.

sf08_platform.caption: Holloway, Pos G: the sculpted Noor out under the single cold-white lamp (about 5000 K, slight green), phone to her ear and lit only by the lamp, framed by the open doors. The car behind the camera is fully relit and asleep.
